benefit.sentenceEn: M: I'm not convinced that the benefits are greater than the disadvantages, but I'll discuss this with your mother.
benefit.translationZh: 男：我不认为利大于弊，但我会和你妈妈讨论这件事。

benefit.sentenceEn: André believes this benefits both her business and her customers.

better.translationZh: 预防胜于治疗，因为肥胖症极难根治。

better.sentenceEn: The instructors said that they also formed a better connection with the students who sat in front.

better.sentenceEn: Various experiments found that participants who cheated in the initial task performed better in the creativity test.

base.translationZh: 我们也会根据穿着来评价自己，因为穿着会影响我们的自我感觉。

base.sentenceEn: We even evaluate people whom we have just met based on their clothes.
base.translationZh: 我们甚至会根据衣着来评价刚刚认识的人。

base.translationZh: 古典音乐和歌剧是现代音乐的基石。

base.sentenceEn: While our initial attraction may be based , in part, on physical chemistry, it is the meeting of our inner worlds that creates the lasting intimacy and spiritual connection for which we long.
base.translationZh: 虽然我们最初的吸引力可能部分源于身体层面的化学反应，但正是我们内心世界的交汇，才创造了我们渴望的持久亲密关系和精神连接。
base.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

base.sentenceEn: Bottled water manufacturers base their arguments against bans of plastic bottles on health concerns rather than on profits.
base.translationZh: 瓶装水制造商反对塑料瓶禁令的理由是出于健康考虑，而非利润。

base.sentenceEn: They were based on the assumption that motivation was the only key.
base.translationZh: 这些都是基于“动力是唯一关键”这一假设而得出的。

behavior.sentenceEn: Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior , our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing.
behavior.translationZh: 科学表明，我们穿的衣服会影响我们的行为、情绪，甚至与他人互动的方式，这是因为我们赋予不同类型的服装以象征意义。
behavior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

behavior.sentenceEn: This means that the experience of wearing something affects our attitudes and our choice of behavior .
behavior.translationZh: 这意味着，穿着某种服饰的体验会影响我们的态度和行为选择。
behavior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

behavior.sentenceEn: Most people don't really believe in them, but research into the impact of clothes on behavior now suggests that there may actually be a grain of truth in these sayings.
behavior.translationZh: 大多数人并不真正相信这些说法，但如今关于着装对行为影响的研究表明，这些俗语中可能确实存在一定的道理。
behavior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

behavior.sentenceEn: The use of rows and their minimal adaptations to "U" shape were traditionally intended to maximize on-task behavior and reduce distraction from the teacher.
behavior.translationZh: 传统上，采用排状排布及其向“U”型布局的微调，旨在最大程度地提高学生的专注度，并减少对教师教学的干扰。
behavior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

behavior.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the passage about the timing of our behaviors ?
behavior.translationZh: 关于我们行为的时间安排，我们可以从这篇文章中了解到什么？

behavior.translationZh: 他们改善了学生的行为表现和学习成绩。

balance.sentenceEn: What we call "work-life balance " is actually just a substitute to having a sense of fulfillment and contentment.
balance.translationZh: 我们所谓的“工作生活平衡”，实际上只是拥有成就感和满足感的一种替代说法。

balance.sentenceEn: Under the management redesign, many steps were taken to ensure better work-life balance and prevent burnout(精疲力竭).
balance.translationZh: 在管理层重组过程中，采取了多项措施以确保更好的工作与生活平衡，并防止员工精疲力竭。

balance.sentenceEn: And if it seems like finding that perfect balance remains difficult to achieve, the experts say that keeping some perspective can help.
balance.translationZh: 如果找到这种完美平衡似乎仍然难以实现，专家表示，保持一定的洞察力会有所帮助。

balance.sentenceEn: Lupu and Ruiz-Castro looked at those who rejected the long hours and they found that those workers actually had strikingly similar strategies for maintaining their work-life balance .
balance.translationZh: 卢普和鲁伊斯-卡斯特罗研究了那些拒绝长时间工作的人，发现这些员工实际上采用了极其相似的策略来维持工作与生活的平衡。

balance.sentenceEn: A retired vice president from a major chemical company stated, "Young women engineers are on an equal footing until they have children, then they struggle to balance work and family—and compete with men who don't have the same household responsibilities."
balance.translationZh: 一家大型化工公司的退休副总裁表示：“年轻女性工程师在生育前与男性处于平等地位，但有了孩子后，她们就要艰难地平衡工作与家庭，还要和那些没有同等家庭责任的男性竞争。”
balance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

balance.sentenceEn: Knowing one's emotional state is of utmost importance in deciding what changes to make for a better work-life balance .
balance.translationZh: 了解自己的情绪状态对于决定如何做出改变以实现更好的工作与生活平衡至关重要。

boost.sentenceEn: In an extensive study published in 2015, researchers analyzed a total of 99 choice studies and specifically looked at those cases in which reducing choices helped to boost sales.
boost.translationZh: 在2015年发表的一项广泛研究中，研究人员分析了总共99项选择研究，并特别关注了减少选择有助于提高销售额的那些案例。
boost.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

boost.sentenceEn: Driving around town in a car is so normal to them that cycling seems weird and unusual — despite its boost from Covid, when bike sales exploded by 75 percent.
boost.translationZh: 在城里开车对他们来说已是家常便饭，以至于骑自行车反而显得有些异类——尽管新冠疫情期间自行车销量暴增了 75%，极大地推动了骑行运动的发展。

boost.sentenceEn: There's a rising amount of data showing that installing bike lanes and making streets more pedestrian-friendly boosts the economic fortunes of a place.
boost.translationZh: 越来越多的数据表明，增设自行车道和打造步行友好型街道，能够显著提升一个地区的经济繁荣度。

boost.sentenceEn: A desire for new life challenges can further boost brainpower.
boost.translationZh: 对新生活挑战的渴望可以进一步提升脑力。
boost.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

boost.sentenceEn: What brought about the boost in ebike sales in Europe at the beginning of the century?
boost.translationZh: 本世纪初欧洲电动自行车销量增长的原因是什么？

boost.sentenceEn: It can boost children's interest in communication.
boost.translationZh: 它可以提高孩子们的交流兴趣。

budget.sentenceEn: "One of the really useful things about this competition," says Hourican, "is that there's a commercial element because the product is going on sale for real and the boys had to learn about budgeting and marketing, as well as designing their game."
budget.translationZh: Hourican说：“这项比赛真正有用的一点是它包含商业元素，因为产品将真正上市销售，男孩们不仅要学习设计游戏，还要学习预算和市场营销。”

budget.sentenceEn: W: We've budgeted for those, and for Internet and transportation.
budget.translationZh: 女：我们已经把这些费用以及网络和交通费用都编入预算了。
budget.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

budget.sentenceEn: The Swiss firm had argued its gold-wrapped chocolate rabbit deserved copyright protection from a similar product sold by the budget supermarket.
budget.translationZh: 这家瑞士公司此前主张，其金箔包装的巧克力兔子应受到版权保护，免受这家廉价超市销售的类似产品的侵害。
budget.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

budget.sentenceEn: As annual inflation climbs over 10%, many households are on tight budgets .
budget.translationZh: 随着年通货膨胀率攀升至10%以上，许多家庭的预算都变得非常紧张。
budget.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

budget.sentenceEn: M: In our family, we talk openly about things like the budget for holidays, how taxes reduce your income, and how to shop around for the best deals.
budget.translationZh: 男：在我们家，我们会开诚布公地谈论一些事情，比如假期预算、税收如何减少收入，以及如何货比三家找到最划算的交易。

belief.sentenceEn: Teachers tend to still use this format because of either the need to control students or the belief that the teacher is the most important person in the room.

belief.translationZh: Game Academy 认为其观点有确凿的数据支持。

belief.translationZh: 福特要求我们审视那些无意识的信念，认识到我们几乎从未这样做过，理解最简单的选择都承载着意义，而这种意义能够并且确实在不断变化。
belief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

belief.sentenceEn: First, they paused and reconsidered beliefs such as "I'm a professional, so I should work, work, work", and asked themselves questions like, "What's currently causing me stress?"

belief.sentenceEn: Your current situation in life is built on the beliefs and habits you have been practicing daily.
belief.translationZh: 你当前的生活状况是建立在你日常践行的信念和习惯之上的。

billion.sentenceEn: But that represents a reduction from last year's energy assistance package of over $8 billion .

billion.sentenceEn: Last month, the federal government added $1 billion in funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program, bringing the total to $4.8 billion .

ban.sentenceEn: The Department of Agriculture banned eggs from Mexico in 2012.

ban.sentenceEn: Camping in public parks has now been banned for August and the early part of September because campers dump litter, human waste, and even their tents on the grassland.
ban.translationZh: 由于露营者在草地上丢弃垃圾、人类排泄物甚至帐篷，公共公园现已禁止在8月及9月初进行露营活动。

ban.sentenceEn: It has banned kids under 10 from dining there.

boredom.sentenceEn: Fall in love with boredom and focus your energy on the process, not the product.
boredom.translationZh: 爱上枯燥，将精力专注于过程而非结果。

boredom.sentenceEn: These are the things that will genuinely relieve boredom and make you more effective in the process.
boredom.translationZh: 这些才是能真正缓解无聊感并在此过程中让你变得更高效的方法。

boredom.sentenceEn: But if you're struggling with real boredom and the emptiness it provokes, consider whether you might seek new connections and more significant challenges.
boredom.translationZh: 但如果你正被真正的无聊及其引发的空虚感所困扰，不妨考虑寻求新的人际连接和更有意义的挑战。

boredom.sentenceEn: If you want to reduce boredom and increase your sense of meaning, seek work where you can make a unique contribution, or find a cause you can support with your time and talent.
boredom.translationZh: 如果你想减少无聊感并增强意义感，可以寻找一份能让你做出独特贡献的工作，或者找到一项你可以用时间和才能去支持的事业。

boredom.translationZh: 关于无聊，研究发现了什么？

boredom.sentenceEn: It is filled with interesting episodes to spare readers intolerable boredom .
boredom.translationZh: 书中充满了有趣的情节，让读者免于枯燥乏味。

being.sentenceEn: For social beings who desire love and belonging, wanting to be liked, and caring about the effect we have on others, is healthy and allows us to make connections.
being.translationZh: 对于渴望爱与归属感的社会性生物而言，希望被他人喜欢并在意自己对他人的影响，这是健康的表现，也让我们能够建立人际连接。
being.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

being.sentenceEn: And once you've reached it, congratulations: you've made it; you're a successful human being of the 21st century.
being.translationZh: 一旦你达成了目标，恭喜你：你成功了；你已是一名21世纪的成功人士。

being.sentenceEn: But moving away from a traditional classroom in which a living, breathing human being teaches and interacts with students daily would be a disaster.
being.translationZh: 但是，如果我们放弃传统课堂——在那里，一位活生生的教师每天授课并与学生互动——那将是一场灾难。
being.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

being.sentenceEn: Without understanding, we risk dehumanizing others, writing off human beings simply because we don't comprehend them.
being.translationZh: 缺乏理解，我们就有可能将他人非人化，仅仅因为不理解他们就把他们一笔勾销。

being.sentenceEn: How did language come into being according to researchers?
being.translationZh: 研究人员认为语言是如何形成的？

being.sentenceEn: It could not have come into being without classical music and opera as its foundation.
being.translationZh: 若没有古典音乐和歌剧作为基础，它就不可能诞生。

brand.sentenceEn: Is it a good idea to display luxury brands and other signals of status?
brand.translationZh: 展示奢侈品牌和其他身份象征是个好主意吗？

brand.sentenceEn: He restructured Zentech, once a taxation vehicle for his father's business, and it is now in its fourth year helping international brands enter the Canadian market.
brand.translationZh: 他重组了 Zentech，该公司曾是他父亲业务的节税工具，如今已是其助力国际品牌进入加拿大市场的第四个年头。

brand.sentenceEn: Now, this impressive new accomplishment validates Eleven Madison Park's decision to take meat off the menu and embrace plant-based foods, with Michelin's 2022 New York guide branding it 'a bold vision of luxury dining'.
brand.translationZh: 现在，这一令人瞩目的新成就肯定了 Eleven Madison Park 餐厅将肉类移出菜单并拥抱植物性饮食的决定，米其林 2022 纽约指南也将其誉为‘对奢华餐饮的大胆愿景’。
brand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

brand.sentenceEn: As the owner of multiple sugary drink brands and bottled water, PepsiCo is facing challenges on health and environmental fronts.
brand.translationZh: 作为多个含糖饮料品牌和瓶装水的所有者，百事公司正面临着健康和环境两方面的挑战。

brand.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, international water brands , as well as a range of new companies, are selling high-end reusable bottles.
brand.translationZh: 与此同时，国际水品牌以及一系列新公司正在销售高端可重复使用水瓶。

brand.sentenceEn: America makes the best-known brands of jeans.
brand.translationZh: 美国拥有最知名的牛仔裤品牌。

beginning.sentenceEn: In one study, we asked people online about the goals they set at the beginning of the year.
beginning.translationZh: 在一项研究中，我们在线询问了人们年初设定的目标。

beginning.sentenceEn: Decades of research shows that it can take from 8 to 13 weeks at the beginning of every school year for students to get back to where they were before the summer holiday.
beginning.translationZh: 数十年的研究表明，每个学年开始时，学生们需要8到13周的时间才能恢复到暑假前的学习水平。
beginning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

beginning.sentenceEn: Students who believed that intelligence is fixed—that you are stuck being "not smart" if you struggle in school—showed higher levels of stress hormones when their grades were declining at the beginning of the ninth grade.
beginning.translationZh: 那些认为智力是固定不变的学生——即如果在学校学习遇到困难就会一直“不聪明”的学生——在九年级伊始成绩下滑时，表现出更高水平的压力荷尔蒙。

beginning.sentenceEn: As you'll notice in the video, the mice definitely seem uncomfortable at the beginning of the experiment.
beginning.translationZh: 正如你在视频中会注意到的，实验初期，这些老鼠显然显得很不自在。
beginning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

beginning.sentenceEn: Since the beginning of this century, an increasing amount of time has been shifted in public schools from recess to academic activities.
beginning.translationZh: 自本世纪初以来，公立学校已将越来越多的时间从课间休息转向了学术活动。

beginning.sentenceEn: They continued to behave as they did in the beginning .
beginning.translationZh: 它们继续保持着最初的行为方式。

bacterium.sentenceEn: Bacteria accumulate because there isn't enough water in your mouth to wash it away, Sunshine can stop you from sweating, too.
bacterium.translationZh: 由于口腔内水分不足无法将细菌冲走，细菌便会堆积。阳光也可能让你停止出汗。
bacterium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

bacterium.sentenceEn: However, bacteria have been shown to live on cabin surfaces, so wash your hands frequently.
bacterium.translationZh: 然而，已有证据表明机舱表面存在细菌，因此请经常洗手。
bacterium.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

bacterium.sentenceEn: They reported bacteria were transferred from the tiles to the cookies within five seconds, but didn't report the specific amount of bacteria that made it from the tiles to the food.
bacterium.translationZh: 他们发现细菌在五秒内就从瓷砖转移到了饼干上，但并未报告从瓷砖转移到食物上的具体细菌数量。

bacterium.sentenceEn: Also, certain types of bacteria are extremely harmful, and it takes only a small number to make you sick.
bacterium.translationZh: 此外，某些类型的细菌具有极强的危害性，只需少量就能让人生病。

bacterium.sentenceEn: To find out, we introduced bacteria to squares of tile, carpet or wood.
bacterium.translationZh: 为了找到答案，我们将细菌接种到瓷砖、地毯或木材的方块表面上。

bacterium.sentenceEn: Whether food is contaminated depends much on the number of bacteria that get onto it.
bacterium.translationZh: 食物是否受到污染，很大程度上取决于沾染到食物上的细菌数量。

block.sentenceEn: It's a plastic sheet that blocks blue light.
block.translationZh: 这是一张能阻挡蓝光的塑料膜。
block.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

block.sentenceEn: M: So blue light is harmful and that's why you want to block it.
block.translationZh: 男：这么说蓝光是有害的，所以你才要阻挡它。
block.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

block.sentenceEn: They may block us on their social media accounts and stop responding to our emails.
block.translationZh: 他们可能会在社交媒体账号上拉黑我们，并且不再回复我们的电子邮件。
block.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

block.sentenceEn: Employers typically worry that social media is a productivity killer; more than half of U.S. employers reportedly block access to social media at work.
block.translationZh: 雇主通常担心社交媒体会扼杀工作效率；据报道，超过一半的美国雇主在工作场所屏蔽社交媒体访问。
block.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

block.sentenceEn: Once you're committed to something, you've already decided how that future block of time will be spent.
block.translationZh: 一旦你承诺做某件事，就已经决定了未来那段时间的用途。

beauty.sentenceEn: Our society places a high value on physical beauty .
beauty.translationZh: 我们的社会高度重视外在美。
beauty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

beauty.sentenceEn: Trying to look like the magazine pictures can take us on a long ride away from what beauty is really about.
beauty.translationZh: 试图长得像杂志图片里的人，会让我们在追求美的道路上渐行渐远，偏离美的真正意义。
beauty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

beauty.sentenceEn: It may sound trite(老生常谈的), but beauty is only skin deep; it's not what brings love toward us.
beauty.translationZh: 这话听着可能有些老生常谈，但美貌不过是肤浅的外在；它并非能为我们带来爱情的东西。
beauty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

beauty.sentenceEn: Outer beauty can be as much of a curse as a blessing.
beauty.translationZh: 外在美既是一种 blessing，也可能是一种 curse。
beauty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

beauty.sentenceEn: What does the author say about outer beauty ?
beauty.translationZh: 作者对外在美有何看法？

beauty.sentenceEn: It sees lots of personal income wasted on beauty products.
beauty.translationZh: 它看到大量个人收入被浪费在美容产品上。

basis.sentenceEn: There are now at least five different cats who come almost on a daily basis .
basis.translationZh: 现在每天几乎至少有五只不同的猫会来。
basis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

basis.sentenceEn: At the moment, the scientific bases for these applications are non-existent or incredibly weak.
basis.translationZh: 目前，这些应用的科学基础要么根本不存在，要么极其薄弱。
basis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

basis.sentenceEn: Almost half of our daily actions are part of our habits and not decisions, so once the correct habits are in place, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis .
basis.translationZh: 我们日常近半数的行为都源于习惯而非刻意决定，因此一旦养成了正确的习惯，你就会自然而然地在日常生活中践行这些行为。
basis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

basis.sentenceEn: But if you're in a place where you have a basis of trust, conflict can be extremely productive.
basis.translationZh: 但如果你身处一个有信任基础的环境中，冲突可以变得极富建设性。
basis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

basis.sentenceEn: What does productive conflict need as a basis ?
basis.translationZh: 富有成效的冲突需要什么作为基础？

basis.sentenceEn: They are solid scientific bases for application.
basis.translationZh: 它们是应用研究的坚实科学基础。

bean.sentenceEn: Everything from specialist cheeses to sought-after coffee beans gets thrown away every day in the current food system.
bean.translationZh: 在当前的食品体系中，从特制奶酪到备受追捧的咖啡豆，各种食品每天都在被丢弃。
bean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

bean.sentenceEn: Beans are an especially excellent protein substitute.
bean.translationZh: 豆类是一种特别优质的蛋白质替代品。
bean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

bean.sentenceEn: It has instructions for making a winter bean salad.
bean.translationZh: 它包含了制作冬季豆类沙拉的说明。
bean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

bean.sentenceEn: Now our students have a range of different seating options, including a floor desk, couches, stools, bean bags, and the traditional desk-and-chair.
bean.translationZh: 现在我们的学生有多种不同的座椅选择，包括地桌、沙发、凳子、豆袋椅，以及传统的课桌椅。
bean.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

bean.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about coffee beans roasted on Earth?
bean.translationZh: 文章中关于在地球上烘焙的咖啡豆说了什么？
它销售备受追捧的咖啡豆。

behave.sentenceEn: Five-year-olds aren't just aware of their reputations, they also behave strategically to alter their outward image.
behave.translationZh: 五岁的孩子不仅意识到自己的名声，还会策略性地改变自己的外在形象。
behave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

behave.sentenceEn: We need to teach children how to behave like the professionals they are striving to become.
behave.translationZh: 我们需要教导孩子们如何像他们努力成为的专业人士那样行事。
behave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

behave.sentenceEn: They found that when people compete against their rivals, they are more willing to behave unethically to win.
behave.translationZh: 他们发现，当人们与竞争对手较量时，会更愿意为了获胜而做出不道德行为。
behave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

behave.sentenceEn: What we have not yet understood is the way the tiny machines in front of us are changing our skeletons, possibly altering not just the way we behave but even the very shape of our bodies.
behave.translationZh: 我们尚未认识到的是，眼前这些小型设备正在如何改变我们的骨骼，这可能不仅改变我们的行为方式，甚至还会改变我们的身体形态。
behave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

behave.sentenceEn: In what way do babies behave like cats?
behave.translationZh: 婴儿在哪些方面的行为与猫相似？

behave.sentenceEn: The brain behaves as if it were playing a virtual reality video game.
behave.translationZh: 大脑的表现就像是在玩虚拟现实电子游戏。

bone.sentenceEn: But as regards bones , it's definitely use it or lose it: To keep your bones strong you have to keep exercising.
bone.translationZh: 但就骨骼而言，绝对是不用则废：要保持骨骼强健，就必须坚持锻炼。
bone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

bone.sentenceEn: People with stronger bones avoid osteoporosis(骨质疏松症) and all the problems that come with it, like breaks and other disabilities.
bone.translationZh: 骨骼更强健的人可以避免骨质疏松症以及随之而来的各种问题，如骨折和其他身体机能障碍。
bone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

bone.sentenceEn: The researchers found that adults who walked regularly had better bone density throughout their lives than their inactive friends.
bone.translationZh: 研究人员发现，经常散步的成年人在其一生中的骨密度比不运动的同龄人更好。
bone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

bone.sentenceEn: And the best way to get strong, healthy bones is by doing weight-bearing exercises like running, dancing and walking, according to a large study.
bone.translationZh: 一项大型研究表明，获得强健健康骨骼的最佳方式是进行负重运动，如跑步、跳舞和步行。
bone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

bone.sentenceEn: What did the serious bone disease in Red Rum's foot mean to himself and his trainer?
bone.translationZh: 红朗姆的足部严重骨病对它自己和它的驯马师意味着什么？

bone.sentenceEn: She was pierced by a chicken bone .
bone.translationZh: 她被一根鸡骨头卡住了。

burger.sentenceEn: If you tried a vegetable burger years ago and dismissed it as rubbery and flavorless, it's a good time to give meatless meat another chance.
burger.translationZh: 如果你多年前尝试过蔬菜汉堡，觉得它口感像橡胶一样而且毫无味道就不再吃了，那么现在正是给素肉一个重新尝试的好时机。
burger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

burger.sentenceEn: So far, it's a winning strategy: More than nine out of ten consumers who buy Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products also eat meat.
burger.translationZh: 到目前为止，这是一种成功的策略：超过九成购买Beyond Burger和Impossible Foods产品的消费者也食用肉类。
burger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

burger.sentenceEn: Then, when I was tired and hungry, I'd use my phone to order food, like burgers and other junk, instead of going to the canteen, where I could get a healthier meal for half the price.
burger.translationZh: 后来，当我又累又饿的时候，我就用手机点外卖，比如汉堡之类的垃圾食品，而不是去食堂——在那里我能用一半的价钱吃到更健康的饭菜。
burger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

burger.sentenceEn: To help quantify(量化) the costs of a poor diet, I recently tried to estimate this impact in terms of a most famous food, the burger (汉堡包).
burger.translationZh: 为了帮助量化不良饮食的代价，我最近尝试以一种最著名的食物——汉堡包——来估算其影响。

burger.sentenceEn: What do we learn about consumers buying Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products?
burger.translationZh: 关于购买Beyond Burger和Impossible Foods产品的消费者，我们了解到什么信息？

burger.sentenceEn: Order food like burgers and chips.
burger.translationZh: 点些像汉堡和薯条之类的食物。

bar.sentenceEn: Do you ever blend up a protein drink for breakfast, or grab a protein bar following an afternoon workout?
bar.translationZh: 你是否曾将蛋白质饮料混合在一起作为早餐，或者在下午锻炼后拿起一条蛋白棒？
bar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

bar.sentenceEn: When we replace meals with a protein bar or drink, we also risk missing out on the rich sources of antioxidants(抗氧化剂), vitamins and many other benefits of real food.
bar.translationZh: 当我们用蛋白棒或蛋白饮料替代正餐时，也可能错失真正食物所富含的抗氧化剂、维生素和许多其他益处。
bar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

bar.sentenceEn: They set the bar too high, and when people take too long or don't get things quite right, they assume it's due to a lack of effort.
bar.translationZh: 他们设定的标准过高，当人们花费时间过长或未能把事情做得尽善尽美时，他们便会认为这是由于努力不足造成的。
bar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

bar.sentenceEn: But can you be sure you've noted every snack bar in your car, or every handful of nuts at your desk?
bar.translationZh: 但你能确定自己已经记下了车里的每一块零食，或是办公桌上的每一把坚果吗？
bar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

bar.sentenceEn: According to the official news agency, Russian authorities have recovered more than 170 gold bars weighing 20 kilograms each.
bar.translationZh: 据官方通讯社报道，俄罗斯当局已找回170多根金条，每根重20公斤。
bar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

burden.sentenceEn: When we think about attaining success—whether it's landing that job or learning that new skill—our thoughts are immediately burdened by all the things we must first learn.
burden.translationZh: 当我们思考如何取得成功时——无论是获得那份工作还是学习新技能——我们的思绪立即被所有必须首先学习的东西所困扰。
burden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

burden.sentenceEn: But for some parents, the school's restrictions are an unnecessary burden .
burden.translationZh: 但对一些家长来说，学校的这些限制是不必要的负担。
burden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

burden.sentenceEn: They are doing work they care about and are interested in, and doing more of it is not necessarily a burden .
burden.translationZh: 他们正在做自己关心且感兴趣的工作，多做一些也未必是负担。

burden.sentenceEn: W: You discuss three of those problems in the book, improving public education, reducing our nation's healthcare burden , and increasing personal savings.
burden.translationZh: 女：您在书中讨论了其中三个问题：改善公共教育、减轻国家医疗负担，以及增加个人储蓄。
burden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

burden.sentenceEn: In cases where parents are working multiple jobs, are less knowledgeable about college bureaucracies, have limited English language skills, or are not contributing financially to their child's education, the burden of self-advocacy will fall on the student.
burden.translationZh: 如果父母从事多份工作、对大学行政体系不甚了解、英语能力有限，或者无法为孩子提供经济支持，那么自我争取的责任就落在了学生身上。

burden.sentenceEn: They are burdened by their expectation of perfection.
burden.translationZh: 他们被追求完美的期望所困扰。

border.sentenceEn: Customs and Border Protection officials are seeing a rise in people illegally bringing eggs from Mexico into border states, such as Texas.
border.translationZh: 海关与边境保护局官员发现，从墨西哥非法携带鸡蛋进入德克萨斯等边境各州的人数正在增加。
border.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

border.sentenceEn: Officials said most people arriving at international borders with eggs are truthful about their purchases.
border.translationZh: 官员表示，大多数携带鸡蛋抵达国际边境的人都会如实交代其购买情况。
border.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

border.sentenceEn: African leaders plan to turn the continent into a continent without borders .
border.translationZh: 非洲领导人计划将非洲大陆转变为一个无国界的大陆。
border.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

border.sentenceEn: Europe has abolished many internal borders .
border.translationZh: 欧洲已取消了许多内部边界。
border.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

border.sentenceEn: What does the news report say about most people arriving at American borders with eggs?
border.translationZh: 关于大多数携带鸡蛋抵达美国边境的人，新闻报道是怎么说的？

border.sentenceEn: They are a shade of red bordering on brown.
border.translationZh: 它们是一种近乎棕色的红色。

bottled.sentenceEn: A litre of bottled water can cost well over a pound, especially for something fancy that has been sucked through a mountain.
bottled.translationZh: 一升瓶装水的价格很容易就超过一英镑，尤其是那些号称源自山泉的高档品牌。

bottled.sentenceEn: But even if large numbers of people are quitting bottled water because of care for the environment, others are taking it up.
bottled.translationZh: 但即使有很多人因为环保考虑而放弃瓶装水，另一些人却开始饮用瓶装水。

bottled.sentenceEn: Chetan-Walsh argues that bottled water is different because the alternatives are so obvious.
bottled.translationZh: 切坦-沃尔什认为瓶装水有所不同，因为替代方案非常明显。

bottled.sentenceEn: Separate data from other analysts show that last year the British consumed more than 2.2 billion litres of bottled water, including "take-home" and "on-the-go" products.
bottled.translationZh: 其他分析师的独立数据显示，去年英国人消费了超过22亿升瓶装水，包括"家庭装"和"便携装"产品。

bottled.sentenceEn: Bottled water manufacturers base their arguments against bans of plastic bottles on health concerns rather than on profits.
bottled.translationZh: 瓶装水制造商反对塑料瓶禁令的理由是出于健康考虑，而非利润。

bottled.sentenceEn: If we care about plastic waste, why won't we stop drinking bottled water?
bottled.translationZh: 如果我们关心塑料垃圾问题，为什么不停用瓶装水呢？

beneficial.sentenceEn: While this approach is beneficial when you have the time and the decision is important, it is problematic when time is crucial.
beneficial.translationZh: 虽然在时间充裕且决策重大时，这种方法大有裨益；但在分秒必争的情况下，它就会带来问题。
beneficial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

beneficial.sentenceEn: It's well known that physical exercise is beneficial not just to physical health but also to mental health.
beneficial.translationZh: 众所周知，体育锻炼不仅有益于身体健康，也有益于心理健康。
beneficial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

beneficial.sentenceEn: Indeed, social scientists who study young people have found that their digital use can be inventive and even beneficial .
beneficial.translationZh: 事实上，研究年轻人的社会科学家发现，他们对数字技术的使用不仅具有创造性，甚至还有益处。

beneficial.sentenceEn: This and other research challenge the prevailing view that emotional intelligence is uniformly beneficial to its bearer.
beneficial.translationZh: 这项研究及其他相关研究挑战了一种普遍观点，即情商对其拥有者总是有益的。
beneficial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

beneficial.sentenceEn: According to a research paper, drinking fruit juice is beneficial on condition that it is consumed in reasonable amounts.
beneficial.translationZh: 根据一篇研究论文，饮用果汁是有益的，前提是要适量饮用。

beneficial.sentenceEn: Emotional intelligence is generally beneficial to its bearer.
beneficial.translationZh: 情商通常对其拥有者有益。

bias.sentenceEn: "Hiring managers have a strong perception bias against 45+ job candidates — they believe that members of this age group have poor skills and low adaptability," Generation's analysts report.
bias.translationZh: Generation 的分析报告指出：“招聘经理对 45 岁以上的求职者存在严重的认知偏见——他们认为这一年龄段的员工技能不足且适应能力差。”

bias.sentenceEn: But in the real world, funding may introduce biases .
bias.translationZh: 但在现实世界中，资金可能会引入偏见。
bias.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

bias.sentenceEn: A little examination can go a long way towards identifying bias associated with the funding source.
bias.translationZh: 稍作审查，就能在很大程度上识别出与资金来源相关的偏见。
bias.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第10句

bias.sentenceEn: Furthermore, science has many safeguards in place to catch instances of bias that affect research outcomes.
bias.translationZh: 此外，科学领域设有诸多保障机制，以发现那些影响研究结果的偏见情况。
bias.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

bias.sentenceEn: Attitudes towards paternity leave(陪产假) have drastically changed in America in the last five years as more fathers feel comfortable taking extended time off, but gender bias persists when it comes to career prospects and the home, according to a new study of working parents.
bias.translationZh: 一项针对职场父母的新研究显示，在过去五年中，美国社会对陪产假的态度发生了巨大变化，越来越多的父亲愿意休更长时间的陪产假，但在职业前景和家庭事务方面，性别偏见依然存在。

bias.sentenceEn: Its hidden biases should be identified independently.
bias.translationZh: 其隐藏的偏见应当被独立识别出来。

beer.sentenceEn: I think we should get some beer and wine, and some fruit juice, and other soft drinks.
beer.translationZh: 我觉得我们应该买些啤酒、葡萄酒、果汁，还有其他软饮料。
beer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

beer.sentenceEn: They may be ancient "beer-making tools," and the earliest direct evidence of beer brewing in China, the researchers reported in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.
beer.translationZh: 研究人员在《美国国家科学院院刊》上报告称，这些容器可能是古代的“酿酒工具”，也是中国最早的直接酿酒证据。
beer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

beer.sentenceEn: Hops(啤酒花), for example, which give many a modern beer its bitter flavor, are a relatively recent addition to the beverage.
beer.translationZh: 例如，为许多现代啤酒带来苦味的啤酒花，是相对较晚才添加到这种饮品中的成分。
beer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

beer.sentenceEn: The majority of the grains, about 80%, were from cereal crops like barley(大麦), and about 10% were bits of roots, including lily, which would have made the beer sweeter, the scientists say.
beer.translationZh: 科学家表示，这些谷物中约80%来自大麦等谷类作物，约10%是包括百合在内的植物根茎碎片，这会让啤酒更甜。
beer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

beer.sentenceEn: Based on that timing, they indicate barley may have arrived in the region not as food, but as raw material for beer brewing.
beer.translationZh: 根据这一时间线，研究人员指出，大麦传入该地区可能并非作为食物，而是作为酿造啤酒的原料。
beer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

beer.sentenceEn: He runs a pub that serves excellent beer .
beer.translationZh: 他经营着一家供应优质啤酒的酒吧。

bilateral.sentenceEn: A video from the project shows a train of autonomous robots running along a track without bilateral control; they eventually back up in phantom jams.
bilateral.translationZh: 该项目的一段视频显示，一列自主机器人沿着轨道运行，没有进行双边控制；它们最终在幽灵拥堵中后退。

bilateral.sentenceEn: The bilateral control approach would include adding rear-facing sensors to determine the distance to the vehicle following a car.
bilateral.translationZh: 双边控制方法将包括添加后视传感器，以确定与跟随车辆的距离。

bilateral.sentenceEn: "But with bilateral control, you could almost double that."
bilateral.translationZh: 但通过双边控制，你几乎可以将其翻倍。

bilateral.sentenceEn: The researchers made computer models of real-world traffic conditions, showing how a typical U.S. freeway could benefit from cars using bilateral control.
bilateral.translationZh: 研究人员制作了真实交通状况的计算机模型，展示了典型的美国高速公路如何从使用双侧控制的汽车中受益。

bilateral.sentenceEn: But when the robots are switched over to bilateral control (by flashing the lights in the room), each autonomous robot tries to keep itself halfway between the robot in front and the one behind; the phantom jams disappear as a result, Horn said.
bilateral.translationZh: 霍恩表示，但当机器人切换到双边控制模式（通过闪烁房间内的灯光实现）时，每个自主机器人都会努力将自己保持在前方机器人和后方机器人之间的中间位置；结果，幽灵拥堵现象便消失了。

bilateral.sentenceEn: Horn has found that certain creatures use strategies similar to bilateral control to avoid hitting each other while moving in dense crowds.
bilateral.translationZh: 霍恩发现，某些生物在密集群体中移动时会采用类似于双边控制的策略来避免相互碰撞。

blame.sentenceEn: But recent studies show a lack of exercise is not to blame for rising obesity rates.
blame.translationZh: 但近期的研究表明，运动不足并非导致肥胖率上升的原因。
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

blame.sentenceEn: It seems like you're blaming them for not succeeding, when poor performance in school isn't a child's fault.
blame.translationZh: 你似乎在责怪他们没有成功，但在学校表现不佳并不是孩子的错。
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

blame.sentenceEn: The 55-year-old woman's neighbors blame her for making the area's rat problem worse.
blame.translationZh: 这位55岁妇女的邻居指责她加剧了该地区的老鼠问题。
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

blame.sentenceEn: For more than a decade, they have been under attack from e-commerce giants, blamed for making Americans fat, and accused of contributing to climate change.
blame.translationZh: 十多年来，超市一直受到电商巨头的冲击，被指责导致美国人肥胖，还被指控加剧了气候变化。
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

blame.sentenceEn: For as long as there are homeless people, there is a tendency to blame the victims themselves for their condition—to see their failure to thrive as an issue of character, of moral weakness, of laziness.
blame.translationZh: 只要存在无家可归者，人们往往就会将他们的处境归咎于其自身——将他们未能过上好生活视为性格问题、道德弱点或懒惰所致。
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

blame.sentenceEn: They claim that lack of exercise is to blame for the increasing obesity rates.
blame.translationZh: 他们声称，运动不足是导致肥胖率上升的原因。

barely.sentenceEn: Over the next century, he predicted, the economy would become so productive that people would barely need to work at all.
barely.translationZh: 他预测，在下个世纪，经济将变得极具生产力，人们几乎不需要工作。

barely.sentenceEn: The typical supermarket layout has barely changed over the past 90 years.
barely.translationZh: 典型的超市布局在过去90年里几乎没有变化。
barely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

barely.sentenceEn: His feet could barely reach the brake, and his head was only just high enough to see out of the windows.
barely.translationZh: 他的脚勉强能够到刹车，头也刚好高到能看清窗外。
barely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

barely.sentenceEn: W: No, but the train was so packed that I could barely move, and it was difficult to breathe too.
barely.translationZh: 女：不是延误，但是地铁太挤了，我几乎动弹不得，呼吸都困难。
barely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

barely.sentenceEn: Talking about work-life balance is said to be a privilege reserved for the better-off, not for those who barely make a living.
barely.translationZh: 据说，谈论工作与生活的平衡是一种特权，只有境况较好的人才享有，而非那些勉强糊口的人。

barely.sentenceEn: She could barely respond to all her 500 Facebook friends.
barely.translationZh: 她几乎无法回复她那500位Facebook好友的所有消息。

broad.sentenceEn: Communicative abstraction, according to the researchers, reflects the tendency of people to use "abstract speech that focuses on the broader picture and ultimate purpose of action rather than concrete speech focusing on details and the means of attaining action."
broad.translationZh: 研究人员称，交际抽象化反映了人们倾向于使用"关注更广阔图景和行动最终目的的抽象语言，而非关注细节和实现行动手段的具体语言"。
broad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

broad.sentenceEn: It defies our increasing awareness of the harm plastics do to the environment and a broader , growing sense that something has to change.
broad.translationZh: 这与我们对塑料危害环境的日益认识以及一种日益普遍的共识——即必须做出改变——背道而驰。

broad.sentenceEn: The platform currently offers professor-led lectures on a broad range of topics, from data science to fashion design.
broad.translationZh: 该平台目前提供由教授主讲的各类课程，涵盖从数据科学到时装设计等广泛领域。
broad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

broad.sentenceEn: He added: "The broader sport is a little too inward-looking, and we need to be more open. In some ways, I'm glad to be coming from the outside. The guys who are in the sport forever are sitting there saying: 'We can't do that. We can't do that because it's never been done that way.'"
broad.translationZh: 他补充道："这项运动整体上有些过于内向，我们需要更加开放。在某些方面，我很高兴能以外部人的身份加入。那些在这项运动中待了一辈子的人总是说：'我们不能那样做。我们不能那样做，因为从来没有人那样做过。'"

broad.sentenceEn: "Depending on a greater number of plant species creates a more vigorous and less risky food system—and one that provides a broader range of nutritional requirements."
broad.translationZh: 依赖更多种类的植物物种能够构建一个更具活力且风险更低的食物系统——同时也能提供更广泛的营养需求。

broad.sentenceEn: We often chalk up our stress to broad experiences like work.
broad.translationZh: 我们常常把压力归咎于工作这样宽泛的经历。

badly.sentenceEn: I landed badly during a fall and twisted it a little, but it's no big deal.
badly.translationZh: 我摔倒时落地姿势不对，稍微扭了一下脚踝，但没什么大不了的。
badly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

badly.sentenceEn: My main problem is that my study folder is full of notes and worksheets, and is badly disorganized.
badly.translationZh: 我的主要问题是，我的学习文件夹里塞满了笔记和练习题，而且乱七八糟的，毫无条理。
badly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

badly.sentenceEn: Even Philip Zimbardo, the author of the Stanford prison experiment, who showed how easily we can be led to behave badly , believes that the future of deviance research may lie more in understanding extreme pro-social behavior, such as heroism.
badly.translationZh: 即便是菲利普·津巴多——那位揭示了我们多么容易被诱导做出不良行为的斯坦福监狱实验的作者——也认为，越轨行为研究的未来可能更多地在于理解极端亲社会行为，例如英雄主义。

badly.sentenceEn: Fortunately, all the blueprints for both the building and its contents have been preserved, so we've been able to replace badly damaged furniture.
badly.translationZh: 幸运的是，这座建筑及其内部所有物品的设计蓝图都保存了下来，因此我们能够更换那些严重损坏的家具。
badly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

badly.sentenceEn: The research argued that boys often perform badly in mixed schools because they become discouraged when their female peers do better earlier in speaking and reading skills.
badly.translationZh: 该研究认为，男孩在男女混合学校中往往表现不佳，因为当女同学在语言表达和阅读能力方面较早表现出色时，他们会感到气馁。
badly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

badly.sentenceEn: His study folder is badly disorganized.
badly.translationZh: 我的学习文件夹杂乱无章。

bite.sentenceEn: "Maybe the best sign that Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat is that I couldn't stand to take another bite ," she wrote.
bite.translationZh: 她写道：“或许 Impossible Foods 已经破解了制作逼真素肉的密码，最明显的迹象就是我再也吃不下去了。”
bite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

bite.sentenceEn: For example, other studies have found dogs are more likely to bite children versus adults.
bite.translationZh: 例如，其他研究发现狗更容易咬伤儿童而非成人。
bite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

bite.translationZh: 随后，河村咬了一下金牌。
bite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

bite.sentenceEn: Some Olympians said they treat their medals as treasures and that it was disrespectful and unacceptable for Kawamura to bite one.
bite.translationZh: 一些奥运选手表示，他们视奖牌为珍宝，而河村咬奖牌的行为既不尊重也令人无法接受。
bite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

bite.sentenceEn: Biting a medal in front of journalists and photographers has become a common pose for Olympic medalists.
bite.translationZh: 在记者和摄影师面前咬奖牌已成为奥运会奖牌得主的常见姿势。
bite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

bite.sentenceEn: He bit a softball player's Olympic gold medal.
bite.translationZh: 他咬了一位垒球运动员的奥运金牌。

bond.sentenceEn: These closer bonds and greater attachment pay off.
bond.translationZh: 这种更紧密的关系和更强的归属感带来了回报。
bond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

bond.sentenceEn: It also provides a great opportunity to bond with friends and family, far away from electronics and other distractions at home.
bond.translationZh: 散步还为你提供了与朋友和家人增进感情的绝佳机会，让你们远离家中的电子设备和其他令人分心的事物。
bond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

bond.sentenceEn: The researchers explained that "Many owners regard their pets as a family member, and form close social bonds with them."
bond.translationZh: 研究人员解释道：“许多主人将宠物视为家庭成员，并与它们建立了密切的社会联系。”
bond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

bond.sentenceEn: There's an endless amount of scientific data proving that dogs can develop strong bonds with their owners.
bond.translationZh: 大量科学数据证明，狗能与主人建立牢固的情感纽带。
bond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

bond.sentenceEn: Now our furry friends don't really experience "romantic" love like in the movies, but they can form deep and lasting bonds with their fellow dogs as well as humans.
bond.translationZh: 当然，我们这些毛茸茸的朋友们并不会体验到电影中那种"浪漫"的爱情，但它们确实能与其他狗狗以及人类建立深厚而持久的情感纽带。
bond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

bond.sentenceEn: Avoiding conflicts may have helped dogs develop better bonds with humans.
bond.translationZh: 避免冲突可能帮助狗狗与人类建立了更好的关系。
bond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第13句

boom.sentenceEn: What both sides accept is that there has been a boom in the past few months, with increasing numbers of visitors pitching their tents on any bit of land they fancy in the UK.
boom.translationZh: 双方都承认的是，过去几个月出现了一股热潮，越来越多的游客在英国随意选择自己喜欢的地方搭起帐篷。
boom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

boom.sentenceEn: Most of the coverage of the boom in wild camping has been negative.
boom.translationZh: 关于野外露营热潮的报道大多持负面态度。
boom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

boom.sentenceEn: One person described it as a loud boom , similar to a plane crash.
boom.translationZh: 有人形容那是一声巨响，类似飞机失事的声音。
boom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

boom.sentenceEn: Flavoured water is booming : sales of the sparkling variety shot up by 20%, according to the latest analyst data.
boom.translationZh: 风味水市场正在蓬勃发展：最新分析师数据显示，气泡型风味水销量飙升20%。

boom.sentenceEn: This is because of a boom in petroleum chemical production from the U.S.

boom.sentenceEn: It still has a chance to give rise to a boom in the global economy.
boom.translationZh: 它仍有机会引发全球经济的繁荣。

bubble.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

bubble.sentenceEn: How did these personal bubbles arise?
bubble.translationZh: 这些个人空间气泡是如何形成的？

bubble.sentenceEn: Those are the average sizes of American's personal bubbles , anyway.
bubble.translationZh: 不过，这些只是美国人个人空间气泡的平均大小。
bubble.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

bubble.sentenceEn: As we all know, cultural or individual differences in personal bubble diameters are all too often the cause of discomfort.
bubble.translationZh: 众所周知，个人空间范围的文化差异或个体差异往往是引起不适的原因。
bubble.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

bubble.sentenceEn: When are the sizes of our bubbles fixed?
bubble.translationZh: 我们的气泡大小是何时固定的？

bubble.sentenceEn: It causes the bubble around us to vanish.
bubble.translationZh: 它会导致我们周围的空间泡消失。

battery.sentenceEn: It has no batteries , if that's what you mean.
battery.translationZh: 如果你是这个意思的话，它不需要电池。
battery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

battery.sentenceEn: It made every effort to keep the essential capabilities of smartphones, but strip out costs and preserve battery life for people who likely have inadequate access to electricity.
battery.translationZh: 该公司竭力保留智能手机的核心功能，同时剔除不必要的成本，并延长电池续航时间——这对于那些很可能无法稳定获取电力的用户来说至关重要。
battery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

battery.sentenceEn: Batteries can pose a particular danger.
battery.translationZh: 电池可能会造成特别的危险。
battery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第13句

battery.sentenceEn: The industry is benefiting from improved batteries as suppliers over the years developed technology for laptops, smartphones and electric cars.
battery.translationZh: 随着供应商多年来为笔记本电脑、智能手机和电动汽车开发技术，电池性能得到了改善，电动自行车行业正从中受益。
battery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

battery.sentenceEn: In 2004, the price of batteries used on ebikes fell, spurring European sales.
battery.translationZh: 2004年，电动自行车所用电池的价格下降，刺激了欧洲市场的销量。
battery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

battery.sentenceEn: They boast the longest battery life.
battery.translationZh: 它们的电池续航时间最长。

beverage.translationZh: 20世纪70年代至90年代，蛋白质产品虽仍有市场，但关注度有所下降，因为多项研究表明糖和饱和脂肪的摄入与心脏病有关，此后低热量、低脂肪、无糖的零食和饮料成为饮食界的焦点。
beverage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

beverage.sentenceEn: These beverages included soda, energy drinks and sports drinks.
beverage.translationZh: 这些饮料包括苏打水、能量饮料和运动饮料。

beverage.sentenceEn: Beverages like pure fruit juice which are sweet but do not contain added sugar were not part of the study.
beverage.translationZh: 像纯果汁这类虽然甜味但不含添加糖的饮料并未纳入本研究范围。

beverage.sentenceEn: A new study finds that beverages containing added sugar might be harmful.
beverage.translationZh: 一项新研究发现，含有添加糖的饮料可能有害健康。

beverage.sentenceEn: The scientists say that their results support limiting beverages with added sugar.
beverage.translationZh: 科学家们表示，他们的研究结果支持限制含添加糖饮料的摄入。

beverage.sentenceEn: One large beverage company has adapted its operations when confronted with challenges from health and environmental advocates.
beverage.translationZh: 一家大型饮料公司在面临健康和环保倡导者的挑战时，调整了其运营方式。

bonus.translationZh: 额外的惊喜是，获奖者会在次年春天看到自己的设计产品上市销售。

bonus.sentenceEn: For those who are overweight or obese, they could receive the bonus if they reduce their weight by 10% during the year.

bonus.translationZh: 这意味着体重对个人而言可能难以控制，因此这种奖金制度有失公允。

bonus.sentenceEn: To qualify for the bonus , they must maintain a healthy weight.
bonus.translationZh: 要获得这笔奖金，员工必须保持健康体重。

blog.translationZh: 为得出这一结论，研究人员对60多万篇博客文章中的男性和女性语言模式进行了分析。

blog.translationZh: 不过我看过你的博客，你写过一些小至20平方米的房子。
